name: Çevre · Environment
desc: Writing Task 2'nin en sık konusu: iklim, kirlilik, enerji
cards: long-term changes in global temperatures and weather patterns
Climate change is often described as the greatest challenge of our time.
the gradual rise in the Earth's average temperature
Global warming is largely caused by burning fossil fuels.
a gas, such as carbon dioxide, that traps heat in the atmosphere
Governments have promised to cut greenhouse gas emissions by half.
the amount of carbon dioxide a person or activity produces
Flying less is one of the easiest ways to reduce your carbon footprint.
gases or substances released into the air
Vehicle emissions are a major source of urban air pollution.
fuels such as coal, oil and gas formed from ancient organisms
Many countries still depend heavily on fossil fuels for electricity.
energy from sources that do not run out, like sun and wind
Investment in renewable energy has grown rapidly in the last decade.
able to continue without damaging the environment
Cities need more sustainable forms of public transport.
the cutting down of large areas of forest
Deforestation destroys the habitats of countless species.
the natural home of an animal or plant
Rising sea levels threaten the habitat of many coastal birds.
the variety of plant and animal life in an area
Protecting biodiversity is essential for healthy ecosystems.
a type of animal or plant that may soon disappear
The tiger is an endangered species in many parts of Asia.
the situation in which a species no longer exists
Without urgent action, many insects face extinction.
all the living things in an area and how they affect each other
Plastic waste is damaging marine ecosystems.
harmful substances in the air, water or land
Noise pollution can have serious effects on mental health.
to make something dirty or harmful by adding a substance
Chemicals from factories can contaminate rivers and lakes.
the process of getting rid of rubbish
Poor waste disposal leads to health problems in crowded cities.
a place where large amounts of rubbish are buried
Most household rubbish still ends up in landfill.
to treat used materials so they can be used again
Residents are encouraged to recycle glass, paper and plastic.
plastic items designed to be used once and thrown away
Several countries have banned single-use plastic bags.
a long period with little or no rain
The drought caused serious food shortages in the region.
a large amount of water covering land that is usually dry
Heavy rain caused floods across the north of the country.
a natural event such as an earthquake or flood that causes damage
Poorer countries often suffer most from natural disasters.
the average height of the sea's surface
Rising sea levels could make some islands uninhabitable.
the protection of nature and natural resources
Conservation projects have helped some whale populations recover.
materials such as water, wood and minerals found in nature
We are using natural resources faster than they can be replaced.
the amount of something that people use
Energy consumption rises sharply in winter.
Electric buses are a more environmentally friendly option.
adding no extra carbon dioxide to the atmosphere overall
The company aims to become carbon neutral by 2035.
Solar power is becoming cheaper every year.
an area with many wind turbines that produce electricity
A new wind farm will supply power to fifty thousand homes.
to make a determined effort to deal with a problem
Individuals alone cannot tackle climate change.
to take action to deal with a problem
Governments must take measures to protect forests.
impossible to change back to a previous state
Some damage to coral reefs may be irreversible.
the process of something becoming worse in quality
Soil degradation reduces the amount of food farmers can grow.
the uncontrolled spread of a city into the countryside
Urban sprawl increases car use and destroys farmland.
designed to cause little harm to the environment
More shoppers are choosing eco-friendly products.
a person who works to protect the environment
Environmentalists have criticised the new airport plan.
Some argue governments should impose a tax on frequent flyers.
to make people know more about a problem
Schools play a key role in raising awareness of environmental issues.
